title: Perps — venue trade history visible in the Activity surface
description: From Perps home, opens the Activity screen through the real Activity section header (renders the generic ActivityView; the dedicated PerpsTransactionsView is unrouted dead code on this branch) and verifies the venue's trade history renders (rows served by the ACTIVE provider's history reads — fills/orders/funding — so on Lighter these are genuine Lighter venue records).

home.intent: Land on Perps home where the Activity section lives.

settle-home.intent: Let the recent-activity section load its rows.

open-activity.intent: Open the full Activity screen from the section header.

settle-activity.intent: Let the transactions list mount and fetch history.

list-present.intent: The Activity list is on screen (the generic ActivityView — the dedicated PerpsTransactionsView is unrouted; perps rows are served by the active provider history reads).

row-present.intent: A venue trade row (Open/Close Long) is visible in the list.

shot.intent: Record the venue history rendered in the Activity screen.
